pages.text: Gravity is a gentle pull. We cannot see it, but we feel it every day.
Gravity keeps our feet on the ground. It stops us from floating away.
When you drop a ball, gravity pulls it down to the ground.
Gravity pulls rain from the clouds down to the land.
Earth’s gravity is strong. It pulls people, animals, water, and air toward the planet.
Gravity also works in space. Earth’s gravity pulls the Moon and keeps it close.
The Sun has very strong gravity. It pulls planets and keeps them moving in paths around it.
In space, far from planets, gravity feels weaker. Astronauts can float more easily.
Gravity works all the time, everywhere. It quietly keeps the universe together.
At bedtime, we remember: gravity is the gentle pull that keeps us safe and grounded.
